newsitem.title: UK: NWE straight-run fuel - low sulphur margins health.
newsitem.headline: NWE straight-run fuel - low sulphur margins health.

text.p: NWE low sulphur straight run fuel was a touch firmer Wednesday, taking support from good margins.
Dealers said there were few visible sellers and the market was starting to look tight. Product that was available was talked up around $146-147 fob NWE, but no buyer was tempted.
Russian straight run material was still being offered with E-4 pegged around formula +$2 for good quality cargoes while M-100 were assessed around two means +$2/3.
There was market talk that the Russian mazut tariff had been levied retroactively to November 1, but there was no official confirmation from the government in Moscow.
